name: policy-dev
description: Development marketplace for the policy plugin

plugins.name: policy
plugins.description: Tooling for a repo's committed process-policy layer: one rule per file under .policy/rule/ (zero-padded IDs), with its two derived forms (a human narrative doc, an agent-operational doc), plus the judgment calls around adding, syncing, auditing, retiring, and reporting on rules. Ships the mechanism, not any project's actual rules.
